description: Project-wide decisions: pipeline mode, variant, cohort-spanning algorithm weights (num_clusters, beta_scalar, w, c, n_grad_components), and dataset layout (BOLD inputs). Mode-specific constraints + per-entry overrides live in modes.json.
source_note: `source` fields name the file owning the field's authoritative default. Line numbers are intentionally omitted — they drift on every reformat and the file/symbol name is the stable contract.
range_policy: advisory — `min`/`max` fields are UI hints documenting the values authors have validated; the parser/validator in arealmshbm/pipeline/config.py enforces only hard constraints (positivity on numeric fields, enum membership on `values`-typed fields). Out-of-range-but-positive values are accepted at parse time and surface as algorithm-side failures downstream.

entries.notes: Each mode in modes.json constrains this entry's `values` to a single-element list via an override.
Mode B excludes cMSHBM via override (step2 has no xyz-vMF path; Step2Config raises NotImplementedError in step2_pipeline/config.py:__post_init__).

entries.description: L = number of cortical parcels (ROIs). Drives step1 schaefer_resolution, step2/step3 EM.
entries.notes: Quantized to the Schaefer-2018 Kong2022 17-network annot resolutions staged at $MSHBM_ATLAS_DIR/<targ_mesh>/label/{lh,rh}.Schaefer2018_<N>Parcels_Kong2022_17Networks_order.annot (N in {100, 200, ..., 1000}). step1_runners.resolve_group_labels raises FileNotFoundError on any other N.

entries.description: beta weight (consumed by step2 EM in Mode B and by step3 EM).
entries.notes: Internal in step2: beta_scalar * 1000 for gMSHBM, 0 for dMSHBM. Internal in step3: gMSHBM x1000, cMSHBM x1, dMSHBM = 0. Same field drives both steps.

entries.description: Group spatial prior log(theta) weight (step3 EM).
entries.notes: w=0 disables the spatial prior term.

entries.description: MRF Potts smoothness prior weight (step3 EM).
Number of diffusion-embedding components kept after step0. Consumed by step3 (gMSHBM only) and step2 (gMSHBM gradient prior in Mode B).
entries.notes: Bound to Step0Config.num_components AND Step3Config.n_grad_components AND Step2Config.n_grad_components. Changing requires step0 rerun.

entries.description: Display name for the dataset. Required.

entries.notes: Step0 hard-restricts to fsaverage6 (Step0Config._SUPPORTED_MESHES). Other meshes work for step1/2/3 standalone but not via the unified driver.

entries.description: Seed mesh for step1 RSFC profile.
List of subjects, each with sessions and BOLD path pairs (lh, rh).
entries.notes: Subject count constraint depends on mode (see modes.json constraints.num_subjects).
